ci.command: cargo test --manifest-path seams/Cargo.toml --offline -j 2; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; uv run --python 3.12 --with pytest --with pyyaml --with jsonschema --with cryptography --with httpx --with fastapi --with uvicorn --with pydantic python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*_contract.py; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; uv run --python 3.12 --with pyyaml --with jsonschema python contracts/validate_fixtures.py; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; uv run --python 3.12 --with pytest --with pyyaml python -m pytest docs/agents/tests -q -p no:cacheprovider

pytest.command: uv run --python 3.12 --with pytest --with pyyaml --with jsonschema --with cryptography --with httpx --with fastapi --with uvicorn --with pydantic python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider contracts/engine-run/tests scripts/gov/tests scripts/dc/tests

ratchet.command: uv run --python 3.12 --with pytest --with pyyaml --with jsonschema --with cryptography --with httpx --with fastapi --with uvicorn --with pydantic python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider e2e-core/tests/unit/test_e2e_thread_01.py e2e-core/tests/unit/test_e2e_thread_01_live_replay.py
